admin.answerFlagsOnly_one: Everything served has been collected, but {count} thing below needs you.
admin.answerFlagsOnly_other: Everything served has been collected, but {count} things below need you.
admin.flag.priceBody: {no} sold {product} at {recorded}; the price is now {price}
admin.flag.shiftBody: Counted at {time}. The shortfall is recorded against the shift.
admin.byHourAria: Sales per hour from {from} to {to}, highest at {peak}
admin.revokedTitle: Sent by {device} after it was revoked
admin.effect.void: Approving takes {amount} off {no} and puts {items} back in stock.
admin.effect.voidWhole: Approving cancels {no} and puts its {count} items back in stock.
admin.effect.writeOffItem: Approving keeps it as a loss of {amount} at selling price. Rejecting means the {qty} {unit} must be found or charged.
admin.effect.writeOffLines: Approving takes {amount} off {no} as a loss; the stock does not come back. Rejecting keeps it on the order.
admin.effect.comp: Approving gives it free: {amount} is written off and the {item} comes out of stock.
admin.effect.price: Accepting keeps the sale at {recorded}. Marking it short records {amount} lost on this order.
admin.effect.archived: The product was archived before this sale. Keeping it records the {amount} as sold. Rejecting voids it and returns the stock.
admin.effect.revoked: This phone was revoked, so its record was held back. Adding it puts {amount} in the records as sent. Rejecting leaves it out, on record here.
admin.recon.subtitle: Business day 06:00 to 06:00
admin.recon.noShifts: No shifts were opened on this business day.
admin.recon.shortNote: {name}’s shortfall of {amount} is recorded against that shift.
admin.recon.openNote: {name}’s shift will show here when it is closed on {device}.
admin.recon.compare: Compare what staff recorded with your till statement
admin.recon.tillHint: From the M-Pesa till statement for this business day
admin.recon.enterTill: Type the till total to see the difference.
admin.recon.variance.matches: Every M-Pesa payment is accounted for.
admin.recon.variance.notOnTill: Staff recorded M-Pesa that didn’t arrive. Check the payments below.
admin.recon.variance.notRecorded: Money arrived that no one recorded. It may be a sale that was never entered.
admin.recon.closeHint: Available when every shift is closed and the till total is entered. You can close with a difference, and it’s kept on record.
admin.recon.closedBy: Day closed by {name} at {time}. The till total and any difference are kept on record.
admin.feed.fullHistory: full history in the audit log
admin.feed.serversNote: Amounts in KES. “Not paid” is money still on that server’s open orders. Sales are credited to the server, and the person who recorded them is shown on every row.
admin.product.saved: Saved. Counters get the change when they next sync.
admin.product.isArchived: This product is archived: counters don’t show it.
admin.product.nameSwHint: optional, shown when the counter is in Kiswahili
admin.product.modeChanged: The stock is now counted in {unit}. Check the figure under In stock before saving.
admin.product.deductHintMl: A tot is 30 ml here. Change it to match your measure.
admin.product.deductHintCount: Each sale takes away this many items.
admin.product.alertLevel: Warn when stock is at or below
admin.product.error.name: Give the product a name.
admin.product.error.size: Every size needs a label, what it takes away (a whole number above 0) and a price.
admin.product.error.sizes: Keep at least one size on sale, or archive the product.
admin.stock.clears: {name} goes back above zero, from {before} to {after}. The flag on Today will clear.
admin.stock.kegNote: The keg goes into the keg queue. It becomes active when the current one is marked finished.
admin.stock.audit: Recorded in the audit log with your name and the delivery note.
admin.kegs.foam: Some foam loss is normal. Your foam allowance is {count} cups. Change it in settings so small losses don’t raise a flag.
admin.kegs.everySale: See every sale from this keg
admin.kegs.none: No keg products yet. Add a product in the Keg category to track kegs.
admin.kegs.since: Tapped {when}. Since then: {mugs} mugs + {jugs} jugs recorded, which is {litres} L. The level is worked out from sales, not measured.
admin.kegs.noneOnTap: Nothing on tap. Add a keg with a delivery and it goes on tap.
admin.kegs.noneOnTapQueue: Nothing on tap. The next keg in the queue goes on tap when a counter starts selling from it.
admin.kegs.queueNote: When staff tap “Keg finished” on the counter, the next keg in the queue becomes active and the old one gets a summary.
admin.staff.demoCode: This is the demo: no phone can pair with this code. With your Kaunta Book server set up, the new phone types it to connect.
admin.staff.pairHow: Open Kaunta Book on the new phone and choose “This is a counter”. Then make a pairing code here.
admin.staff.addHint: Counter staff log in with the 4-digit PIN you set here; you can look it up or change it any time. Servers don’t log in. Kaunta adds managers.
admin.staff.codeHow: Give this code to {name}. At a counter they tap their name, type the code and choose a new PIN. It works once, for {hours} hours. It is not shown again.
admin.staff.peopleHint: Counter staff log in with a PIN. Servers who only carry drinks don’t need a login, but they still appear in the server picker.
admin.staff.resetNote: Resetting a PIN gives a one-time code. The person sets their own new PIN at the counter, so admins never see it. Archived people keep their history.
admin.staff.reason.left: Left with someone who no longer works here
admin.staff.revokeNote: Revoking signs the phone out straight away. Anything it saved offline and hasn’t sent yet is held for your review, not thrown away.
admin.audit.linesMoved: Items moved from {from} to a new order {to}
admin.audit.pinSet: New PIN set with a one-time code
admin.audit.handedOver: Order {order} handed over to the next shift
admin.audit.handoverAccepted_one: Took over {count} order from the last shift
admin.audit.handoverAccepted_other: Took over {count} orders from the last shift
admin.signIn.title: Sign in to manage your bar
admin.signIn.body: For owners and admins. Counter staff log in on a counter phone with their PIN.
admin.signIn.wrong: That phone number or password is not right. Try again.
admin.signIn.offline: No connection to the server. Check the internet and try again.
admin.signIn.failed: The server could not sign you in just now. Try again in a minute.
admin.signIn.notAdmin: This account is not an owner or admin of this bar. Ask the owner to add you.
login.reset.enterCode: Type the 6-digit code from your admin
login.reset.wrongCode_one: That code is not right · {count} try left
login.reset.wrongCode_other: That code is not right · {count} tries left
login.reset.mismatch: The two PINs were different. Choose a new PIN again.
login.reset.noPin: {name} has no PIN yet. Ask an admin for a one-time code (Staff & devices → Reset PIN).
admin.bars.newHint: It starts with no products and no staff but you. You can switch back at any time.
admin.bars.failed: The bar could not be started. Check the connection and try again.
admin.bars.pickBody: You run more than one bar. Pick one to open. You can switch at any time from the bar’s name at the top.
admin.barCode.title: Bar code for counter phones
admin.barCode.body: On a new counter phone, tap “Open the counter” and type this code once. Staff then log in with their own PIN.
admin.barCode.newConfirm: The old code stops working for new phones. Phones already set up keep working.
admin.barCode.newDone: New code made. Give it only to people who run your counter.
admin.barCode.failed: The code could not be changed. Check the connection and try again.
admin.barCode.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change it.
admin.owner.title: Sign in to run your bars
admin.owner.body: Owners: your username and password. Managers: your username and 4-digit PIN. Kaunta gave you both.
admin.owner.wrong: That username, password or PIN is not right.
admin.owner.wrongLeft_one: That username, password or PIN is not right. {count} try left before this account locks for 15 minutes.
admin.owner.wrongLeft_other: That username, password or PIN is not right. {count} tries left before this account locks for 15 minutes.
admin.owner.locked: Too many wrong tries. This account is locked until {time}. Kaunta can set a new password or PIN sooner.
admin.owner.demoHint: Demo: owner {owner}, password {ownerPassword} · manager {manager}, PIN {managerPin}. Kaunta adds new owners at /super.
admin.owner.noBarsBody: Your account doesn’t run a bar yet. Kaunta adds an owner’s first bar; ask them, or the bar’s owner.
admin.account.title: Your account
admin.account.elsewhere: This sign-in is managed outside Kaunta Book.
admin.account.setByKaunta: Kaunta set your current PIN. Choose one only you know.
admin.account.pinHint: Four digits. You use it for admin and at your counters. Not a birthday.
admin.account.saved: Your PIN is changed. Use it next time you sign in, here or at the counter.
admin.account.mismatch: The two new PINs are different.
admin.account.wrongCurrent: Your current PIN is not right.
admin.account.same: That is your current PIN. Choose a different one.
admin.account.reminder: Kaunta set your PIN. Change it to one only you know.
admin.barCode.rules: 6 to 12 letters or digits, with at least one letter. No other bar may have it; O and 0, and I, L and 1, count as the same.
admin.barCode.invalid: A code is 6 to 12 letters or digits, with at least one letter.
admin.barCode.taken: Another bar already has that code. Choose a different one.
admin.staff.pinHow: Give this PIN to {name}. They use it to log in at the counter and can’t change it; owners and managers can, here. You can look it up any time.
admin.staff.suspendQ: Suspend {name}? They are signed out of every counter at once. What they recorded stays.
admin.staff.pinNote: Owners and managers (and Kaunta) set counter PINs here; staff can’t change their own. Each change is in the audit log, without the digits. Suspending someone takes them off the counter at once.
admin.staff.suspendedHint: They can’t log in at any counter. Their history stays.
admin.account.reminderPassword: Kaunta set your password. Change it to one only you know.
admin.account.setByKauntaPassword: Kaunta set your current password. Choose one only you know.
admin.account.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. You use it for admin and at your counters.
admin.account.savedPassword: Your password is changed. Use it next time you sign in, here or at the counter.
admin.account.mismatchPassword: The two new passwords are different.
admin.account.wrongCurrentPassword: Your current password is not right.
admin.account.invalidPassword: A password is at least 8 characters.
admin.account.samePassword: That is your current password. Choose a different one.
admin.pack.title: Delivered in
admin.pack.hintCount: Crates, boxes or packs, and how many bottles or pieces each holds
admin.pack.hintMl: Boxes of bottles: how many, and which bottle size
admin.pack.label: Pack
admin.pack.alwaysCount: A single bottle or piece is always offered when adding stock.
admin.pack.alwaysMl: One bottle of each size (250 ml and up) is always offered when adding stock.
admin.pack.kept: It stays on this product for the next delivery. Change it under Delivered in on the product.
admin.product.sizesRemoved: Removed when you save: {sizes}. Past sales keep them.
admin.product.alertCount: Warn when the shelf count is at or below
admin.product.alertMl: Warn when stock is at or below
admin.product.alertCountHint: Bottles or pieces on the shelf. From here the counter shows how many are left and Products shows Low.
admin.product.alertMlHint: In ml: 1500 is two 750 ml bottles. From here Products shows Low.
admin.product.error.pack: Each pack needs a name and how many it holds (and a bottle size, for spirits).
admin.managers.title: Managers
admin.managers.hint: They run this bar in admin and sell at the counter with their own 4-digit PIN. They can't start bars or add managers.
admin.managers.removeNote: They can no longer open this bar in admin or sign in at its counter. Their other bars and what they recorded stay.
admin.managers.existingHint: They already run another of your bars. They sign in as before and will see this bar too.
admin.managers.newHint: Give them the username and PIN. They sign in at Owner or manager sign in and can change the PIN under Your account.
admin.managers.error.name: Type their name.
admin.managers.error.username: A username is 3 to 30 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
admin.managers.error.usernameTaken: That username is taken. Choose another.
admin.managers.error.notOwner: Only the owner of a bar can add managers to it.
admin.size.perSizeHintMl: 250 ml and 750 ml bottles are delivered, counted and sold from their own stock. A tot is poured from one of the bottle sizes.
admin.size.perSizeHintCount: Each size (a 500 ml bottle and a can, say) is delivered, counted and sold from its own stock.
admin.size.switchOn: After saving, count each size: until then all {total} is put on the largest size.
admin.size.switchOff: After saving, the sizes' stock is added together into one.
admin.size.title: In stock, by size
admin.size.countOpen: ml left in an open bottle
admin.size.alert: Warn when {size} is at or below
admin.size.alertHint: For each size. From here Products shows Low, and the counter shows how many are left (counted products).
admin.product.error.pour: With stock by size, at least one size keeps its own stock, and every other size is taken from one that does.
admin.product.converted: Worked out from {was} at {ml} ml a bottle. Change it if the shelf says otherwise.
admin.product.stockNowHint: Type what is on the shelf and save. It is kept as a count in the audit log.
admin.product.error.stock: Type how much is in stock.
admin.kaunta.banner: You are in this bar as Kaunta. You can use every tab the owner has. What you do here is not shown in the owner's or managers' logs.
admin.bars.limit: You run as many bars as your plan allows ({max}). Ask Kaunta to add more.
admin.owner.suspendedBody: Kaunta has suspended {bars}. Nobody can open it in admin or sign in at its counters until Kaunta gives access back.
admin.recon.tillPaidOut: − {amount} paid out from the till this day · expect {expected} on the statement
admin.effect.expenseCash: Approve and {amount} stays off the cash expected in the drawer. Reject and {name}’s shift is short by {amount}.
admin.effect.expenseTill: Approve and {amount} stays off what the M-Pesa till should show. Reject and it counts as missing from the till.
admin.audit.voidCancelled: Void request taken back · {order} paid instead
admin.day.title: Sales · {date}
admin.day.question: Did I lose money on {date}?
admin.audit.barReset: Bar reset to new · every earlier record cleared
admin.staff.deleteWhy: Delete {name}? It stops working at once (it is revoked) and leaves this list. Its sales stay in the records.
admin.staff.deleteWhyRevoked: Delete {name} from this list? Its sales stay in the records.
